string.name: agree_continue_format_readingAid
string.value: [TS_945148]_Agree and continue. Please read all terms first.

string.name: sensitive_behavior_statement_of_system_services_detail_softwareupdate
string.value: [TS_1053416]_Software update services need to connect to the Internet and read the list of installed apps.

string.name: sensitive_behavior_statement_of_system_services_detail_device_communication
string.value: [TS_1053419]_Device communication services need to connect to the Internet and read this device's phone number(s), IMEI, SMS/MMS message content, and location information.

string.name: sensitive_behavior_statement_of_system_services_detail_common_security
string.value: [TS_1053407]_Common security services need to connect to the Internet, read location information, as well as read and upload/transfer the list of installed apps, this device's phone number(s), and approximate location information.

string.name: sensitive_behavior_statement_of_system_services_detail_authentication
string.value: [TS_1053411]_The authentication service needs to connect to the Internet to read the list of installed apps.

string.name: sensitive_behavior_statement_of_system_services_detail_auto_discovery
string.value: [TS_1053414]_Auto-discovery services need to connect to the Internet, use Bluetooth and NFC, read and upload/transfer Bluetooth and WLAN MAC addresses, and enable the camera to scan codes.

string.name: sensitive_behavior_statement_of_system_services_detail_picker
string.value: [TS_939799]_Picker services need to read media data (images, videos, and audio), contacts, file data, and the list of installed apps, and enable the camera and microphone. The map picker service needs to connect to the Internet to read and upload/transfer location information.

string.name: sensitive_behavior_statement_of_system_services_detail_system_storage
string.value: [TS_1053410]_System storage services need to read Calendar event data and read and modify contacts and call logs data.

string.name: sensitive_behavior_statement_of_system_services_detail_carrier
string.value: [TS_1053413]_Carrier services need to connect to the Internet, read and upload/transfer this device's phone number(s), IMEI, Bluetooth and WLAN MAC addresses, and approximate location information, and send and receive SMS messages.

string.name: sensitive_behavior_statement_of_system_services_detail_colorpickerservice
string.value: [TS_1177422]_The global color picker service needs to take screenshots in the background.
